ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approx 80%) with a low-intensity black perimeter and scattered focal markings (approx 20%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central region. Irregular low-intensity black border along the trailing edge and lateral tips. Discrete circular black focal spots mapped on the medial left and lateral right lobes. Yellow-brown pigment patches located on the lower left and mid-distal right areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 75 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Densely packed irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) with pixel-depths ranging from 5 to 25 units along the entire visible trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature across the trailing boundaries of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular low-intensity pixel clusters (scars) approximately 5-15 pixels in diameter scattered on the white ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark diagonal linear marks observed on the upper quadrant of the right lobe, angled approximately 40 degrees from the horizontal.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible yellow-brown surface staining on the lower left and outer right lobes. Dense barnacle colonization on the lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetric yellow-tan pigment variation near the distal edge of the right lobe.
